name: Gweike Cloud Pro
tagline: Cloud-connected desktop CO₂ — popular in maker communities
tldr: Gweike Cloud Pro offers enclosed CO₂ cutting with cloud features and competitive pricing vs xTool P2. Good mid-premium CO₂ if you want LightBurn and community support. Verify local warranty before buying.
mainObjective: Connected enclosed CO₂ for acrylic and wood small business work

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm acrylic

pros: Strong CO₂ value in enclosed segment
cons: Cloud features may not appeal to everyone
beginnerNotes: Compare directly with Monport 55W and xTool P2 on price, bed size, and warranty in your country.
proTips: Run LightBurn for production jobs even if cloud UI is convenient for tests.
primaryUse: Mid-premium enclosed CO₂ for acrylic and wood product businesses.
